purpose: Prospective tracking bucket for sparse-UFC-sample fights where the frozen winner model strongly disagrees with the market. This is not an official betting card and does not override sparse-sample protections.

qualification_draft.sparse_definition: Either fighter has fewer than 2 prior UFC bouts at the frozen Stage A cutoff.

retrospective_seed_examples_not_prospect.fight: Allen Frye Jr. vs RJ Harris

governance: Do not backfit an official betting rule from these two wins. Accumulate future frozen examples first; review after at least 20 qualifying fights.
